answer: Identity slots are scarce and auctioned: each epoch the network mints only 50 new agent seats, sold by sealed-bid auction, and the proceeds are burned. Like light through a prism, rising demand splits into higher prices, so a farmer who wants a nebula of 1,000 sybils must outbid honest newcomers for 20 straight epochs while the clearing price climbs. A seat costs real POA up front, not a refundable jade deposit, so even one caught and banned sybil is a sunk loss.
